value: The claim that nominal GDP is calculated at constant prices is wrong — nominal GDP uses current prices
reasoning: Nominal GDP values each year's output at that year's own current prices; it is REAL GDP that is computed at constant (base-year) prices so that quantities of different years become comparable.
Structural unemployment arises when the skills or locations of available workers do not match the skills or locations demanded by employers, so vacancies and job-seekers coexist without clearing.
Stagflation is the simultaneous occurrence of stagnant or slow output growth and rapid inflation, combining the words stagnation and inflation.

Crowding in occurs when higher government spending raises demand and business expectations, inducing extra private investment; crowding out is the opposite effect operating through higher interest rates.
Collateral is the asset a borrower pledges to the lender as security, which the lender can sell to recover the loan if repayment fails.

The nominal interest rate is the percentage excess of money repaid over money borrowed, making no allowance for inflation; the real rate is the nominal rate adjusted for the fall in the money's purchasing power.
